Challenging month a gentle reminder for guests
Please read this before you travel
Companion animal travel notice

Travelers must review the current companion animal checks before departure. Aurelia Skyways requires complete documents, suitable carriers, and early reporting at the Companion Animal Travel Desk.

Please arrive prepared for normal inspection and approval steps. <<FACT F007>> The pet lounge process is managed with care and steady oversight. <<FACT F001>> If a case needs review, staff will guide the next step without delay.

Bring every required item and keep your animal calm throughout handling. For help, speak with the Companion Animal Travel Desk.
